start_here: Say to your AI: "Before you apply this site build, check every kind of page in a browser against the live site." It runs tool:check-a-site-build-in-a-browser on the built folder and tells you each page it refuses, with the reason and the two pictures.
no_lists_because: It keeps nothing: it reads a built folder and the live site and answers what it measured, with pictures in the folder you name.
instructions: 1. Find the built pages folder (and the app folder when the site has a members app) and the live origins.
2. Run the row's command from the Workshop checkout on the computer that holds the build, with --pages, --live and --out (and --app and --live-app).
3. Read the last line: refused is the number of pages not to go live. Exit code 1 means a page is refused, 0 means none is, 2 means it could not run.
4. For each refused page tell the person its kind, the sentences in why and the pictures; do not apply the build.

worked_examples.title: A course page that draws blank
worked_examples.ask: Check this build before it goes live.
worked_examples.given: A built folder whose /courses/<slug> page throws a toUpperCase page error and draws nothing, against a live course page 3,490 px tall.
worked_examples.hands_back: {"result":{"refused":1,"pages":[{"kind":"/courses/*","refused":true,"why":["the built page is 900 px tall, 0.258 of the live page's 3490 px (refused under 0.5)","the built page threw 1 error(s) the live page did not: [\"TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toUpperCase')\"]"]}]}}
